def digest(path):

required={

"isolated_environment":[".venv/bin/python","requirements.lock.txt","pyproject.toml"],
"immutable_data_provenance":["data/raw/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json","data/raw/BH_HTE_Curated_Dataset_v20260219.csv","data/raw/zenodo_public_metadata.json"],
"field_units_missingness_duplicates":["data/audit/fields.csv","data/audit/summary.json","data/audit/raw_duplicate_inputs.parquet","data/audit/duplicate_inputs.parquet","data/audit/raw_source_summary.csv","data/audit/source_summary.csv"],
"label_boundary_discrepancies":["data/audit/label_disagreements.csv","data/audit/yield_exactly_10.csv"],
"quantum_feature_role_audit":["data/audit/qm_role_consistency.csv","data/audit/original_qm.npz"],
"additive_recovery_bound":["reports/ADDITIVE_RECOVERY.md","data/audit/additive_recovery/manifest.json","data/audit/excluded_rows.csv"],
"chemical_mapping_and_token_audit":["data/audit/structure_mapping.parquet","data/audit/entity_rule_sensitivity.csv","data/audit/token_serialization_mapping.parquet","data/audit/token_audit.json"],
"fixed_features_and_nested_splits":["data/processed/feature_manifest.json","data/processed/features.npz","data/processed/records.parquet","data/processed/splits.json","FINAL_EVAL_LOCK.json"],
"generic_checkpoint_and_tokenizer":["weights/rxnfp/manifest.json","weights/rxnfp/tokenizer_extension_manifest.json","weights/rxnfp/pytorch_model.bin","weights/rxnfp/extended_vocab.txt"],
"fit_gradient_throughput_memory":["artifacts/FEASIBILITY.json","artifacts/BUDGET_ESTIMATE.json"],
"groupdro_hand_and_runtime_checks":["reports/GROUPDRO_RUNTIME_CHECK.json","reports/GROUPDRO_COMPLETED_TRAJECTORY_AUDIT.json"],
"all_inner_selection_audits":["reports/FIRST_FOLD_SELECTION_AUDIT.json","reports/HITEA_SELECTION_AUDIT.json","reports/JNJ_SELECTION_AUDIT.json","reports/MERCK_SELECTION_AUDIT.json","reports/ROCHE_SELECTION_AUDIT.json"],
"tree_model_audits":["reports/ALL_TREE_INNER_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json","reports/ALL_FORMAL_TREE_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json","reports/ALL_SENSITIVITY_TREE_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json"],
"main_full_state_and_matched_budget_audit":["reports/ALL_FORMAL_NEURAL_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json","reports/final/training_budget_audit.csv","reports/final/groupdro_trajectories.csv"],
"independent_prediction_and_metric_audit":["reports/PRIMARY_EVALUATION_AUDIT.json","reports/COMMON_ROW_SUMMARY_AUDIT.json"],
"module_and_near_literature_and_journals":["reports/LITERATURE_DIFFERENCES.md","reports/JOURNAL_SCOPE.md","third_party/METHOD_REFERENCE_MANIFEST.json"]
}
checks={}
for name,paths in required.items():
    missing=[path for path in paths if not (root/path).is_file()]
    assert not missing,(name,missing)
    checks[name]={"status":"PASS","paths":paths}
manifest_files=[]
for manifest_path in ["data/raw/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json","weights/rxnfp/manifest.json","third_party/METHOD_REFERENCE_MANIFEST.json"]:
    for item in read(manifest_path)["files"]:
        assert digest(item["path"])==item["sha256"],item["path"]
        manifest_files.append(item["path"])
raw=root/"data/raw/BH_HTE_Curated_Dataset_v20260219.csv"
assert raw.stat().st_mode&0o222==0
for path in ["FINAL_EVAL_LOCK.json","sensitivity/author_labels/FINAL_EVAL_LOCK.json","sensitivity/dd_original/FINAL_EVAL_LOCK.json"]:
    assert (root/path).stat().st_mode&0o222==0,path
summary=read("data/audit/summary.json")
assert summary["raw_rows"]==27497 and summary["main_rows"]==23185
assert summary["label_disagreements"]==28 and summary["at_exactly_10"]==155
assert summary["qm_shape"]==[27497,50] and summary["qm_nonfinite"]==0
metadata=read("data/raw/zenodo_public_metadata.json")
assert any(record.get("license")=="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode" for record in metadata["json_ld"])
fit=read("artifacts/FEASIBILITY.json")
assert fit["used_only_inner_training_rows"] and fit["small_fit"]["encoder_grad_verified"]
assert fit["small_fit"]["training_fit_diagnostic"]["bce"]<0.01
for path in ["reports/ALL_FORMAL_NEURAL_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json","reports/PRIMARY_EVALUATION_AUDIT.json","reports/AUTHOR_LABELS_NEURAL_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json","reports/COMMON_ROW_SUMMARY_AUDIT.json"]:
    assert read(path)["status"]=="PASS",path
report={"checked_utc":dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"status":"PASS","scope":"Static provenance and completed-stage evidence; DD runtime/evaluation and final report remain pending","requirements":checks,"verified_manifest_files":manifest_files,"main_lock_sha256":digest("FINAL_EVAL_LOCK.json"),"completion_claim_permitted":False}
(root/"reports/STATIC_DELIVERY_AUDIT.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","requirement_groups":len(checks),"manifest_files":len(manifest_files)}))
